title: Time Clock user CAN read Work Orders via API
preconds:
1. A user is signed in with the system Time Clock role (Work Orders View, Schedule View, Timesheets View; View Mode none; every other permission OFF; read-only, can clock in/out).
  2. You have a way to send API requests to the backend (api.staging.shopview.com) as that signed-in Time Clock user.
steps:
1. Send GET /api/work-orders?page=1.
  2. Send GET /api/work-orders/view/{workOrderId} for any work order.
expected:
Both requests return 200 OK with the work-order data.

Reason: the Time Clock role has Work Orders View, so reading work orders is allowed.
